title: 96-well to 384-well transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, which includes the custom labware definition JSON file for the Greiner Bio‑One 384‑well plate.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, upload the provided custom labware definition for the Greiner Bio‑One 384‑well plate (see the accompanying JSON file).

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App (requires version 3.19.0 or later).

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck exactly as shown in the deck map:

substeps.instruction: Place the Greiner Bio‑One 384‑well plate in Slot 1.
Place the Nest 0.1 mL 96‑well PCR plate (full skirt) into the 96‑well aluminum block on the Temperature Module.
Load a tip rack of Opentrons 300 µL tips for the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the 384‑well plate, the 96‑well plate, the tip rack, and the Opentrons P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette according to the app’s calibration workflow.

steps.title: Select row‑mapping option
steps.instruction: In the protocol settings, choose whether samples are transferred to odd rows (A/C/E…) or even rows (B/D/F…) of the 384‑well plate.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the automated transfer of samples from the 96‑well plate (on the Temperature Module) to the 384‑well plate.
